subject: Kickoff: sparse convnets on-device track
body:
Team — kicking off the sparse convnets on-device track.

Our open-source release ships TF-Lite models where sparse MobileNetV1 at width 1.0 hits 68.4% top-1 at 90% sparsity with 31ms latency on a Snapdragon 835 — numbers that make an edge-inference tier credible.

Goals this window: (1) validate the published latency table on our current device-lab hardware by May 15; (2) stand up the conversion pipeline for customer models with the paper's sparsity recipe — block size 4 in the last inverted-residual block for V1; (3) run a human-rating study on perceived quality of on-device classifications versus the dense baseline, since top-1 deltas undersell perceived regressions; (4) go/no-go readout by Jul 24.

Vera owns models, Freya the sparsity recipe, Paloma tooling, Nikhil evals. Alina follows up on staffing.

Zofia
